Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/profile/controller/UserProfileController.java only.
- @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/profile') @CrossOrigin
- Autowire UserProfileService via constructor injection.
- Endpoints:
  * @GetMapping('/{userId}'): calls userProfileService.getProfile(userId), returns 200 OK with UserProfile.
  * @PutMapping('/{userId}'): accepts Map request body with {displayName, avatarUrl, measurementUnit, themeMode, isFamilySharingEnabled, isTelemetryEnabled}, calls userProfileService.updateProfile(...), returns 200 OK with updated UserProfile.
  * @GetMapping('/{userId}/audit-logs'): calls userProfileService.getAuditLogs(userId), returns 200 OK with List<SecurityAuditLog>.
- Include clean ExceptionHandler for IllegalArgumentException and NoSuchElementException.
